description: This file defines a Spring MVC controller named IndexController that handles web requests for the application's index page, discover page, login page, and logout success page.

classes.name: IndexController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller handling routing for index, discover, login, and logout pages.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET requests for '/' and '/index', returns the 'index' view.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Handles GET requests for '/discover', returns the 'discover' view.

methods.name: loginPage
methods.description: Handles GET requests for '/login', prepares login page view.

methods.name: logoutPage
methods.description: Handles GET requests for '/logout-success', returns the 'logout' view.
